title: Week 2 eval case
description: One case in the Week 2 gate. One file per case under agent/evals/w2/cases/, so that deleting a case is a visible deletion in a diff rather than a line lost inside a list.

id.description: W2- prefixed because Week 1 already uses bare categories A-I (agent/evals/test_a_*.py ...).

critical.description: Safety-critical. A previously-passing critical case that now fails blocks the merge regardless of any aggregate (design doc, Recommended CI Gate Rule Set, cross-cutting rule 1).

status.description: active: executes today against the contracts, the doc factory or a merged implementation. pending_sut: fully specified, waiting on something not built. delegated: the behaviour is enforced by a named job in the SAME pipeline that this gate cannot run itself — the gate scores whether that delegation is real, not the behaviour. None of the three ever counts as a passing behavioural case except `active`.

expected.description: The behaviour, in a sentence two reviewers would grade identically.

check.description: The registered checker. `pending.*` ids have no implementation yet and belong only to pending_sut cases.

guards_against.description: The failure mode this case exists to catch, in one line.

delegated_to.description: Required for status=delegated, forbidden otherwise. The gate checks every field of this against the repository, so a delegation to a job that does not exist, that is allowed to fail, or to a test that has been deleted is a gate failure rather than a comment.

suite.description: Repo-relative path of the test file that holds the assertions.

tests.description: Test method names that must exist in `suite`.
